## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: ...`, `fix(scope): ...`), see `BRANCHING.md`
- [ ] Branch is `feat/`, `fix/`, `chore/` or `docs/` off the latest `main`
- [ ] Under ~400 changed lines, one concern
- [ ] Gates pass locally (typecheck, lint, tests, build, as the repo has them)
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG / CLAUDE.md updated if behaviour or rules changed
- [ ] No secrets in the diff
